items.heading: The Cbse Class 12 Informatics
items.text: The CBSE Class 12 Informatics Practices curriculum for 2025-26 (subject code 065) has 70 marks of theory and 30 of practical work. Data handling with Pandas and data visualisation carries 25 marks, database queries with SQL carries 25, computer networks carries 10, and societal impacts carries 10.
